{{nihongo|'''Yamadai Shrine'''|山直神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumi Province]].

'''Yamadai Shrine''' (やまだいじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kishiwada, Osaka|ar|كيشيوادا (أوساكا)|arz|كيشيوادا, اوساكا|be|Кісівада|ca|Kishiwada|ce|Кисивада|ceb|Kishiwada Shi|de|Kishiwada|eo|Kishiwada|es|Kishiwada|eu|Kishiwada (Osaka)|fa|کیشی‌وادا، اوساکا|fi|Kishiwada|fr|Kishiwada|ga|Kishiwada|gl|Kishiwada|hr|Kishiwada|hy|Կիսիվադա|id|Kishiwada, Osaka|it|Kishiwada|ja|岸和田市|ko|기시와다시|lt|Kišivada|mg|Kishiwada|mzn|کیشی‌وادا، اوساکا|nl|Kishiwada|no|Kishiwada|pl|Kishiwada|pt|Kishiwada|ro|Kishiwada|ru|Кисивада|sh|Kishivada|simple|Kishiwada, Osaka|sr|Кишивада|sv|Kishiwada|tg|Кишиуада|th|คิชิวาดะ|tl|Kishiwada|tr|Kishiwada|tt|Кисивада|uk|Кішівада|ur|کیشیوادا، اوساکا|vi|Kishiwada, Ōsaka|war|Kishiwada, Osaka|zh|岸和田市|zh_classical|岸和田市|zh_min_nan|Kisiwada-chhī|zh_yue|岸和田|qid=Q740456}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. Its honden and other structures are designated {{ill|Tangible Cultural Property (Japan)|Q2901860|qid=Q2901860}}.

Jierhunnert|su|Abad ka-8|sv|700-talet|sw|Karne ya 8|ta|8-ஆம் நூற்றாண்டு|tg|Садаи VIII|th|คริสต์ศตวรรษที่ 8|tk|8-nji asyr|tl|Ika-8 dantaon|tr|8. yüzyıl|tt|VIII гасыр|uk|VIII століття|ur|آٹھویں صدی|uz|VIII asr|vec|VIII secolo|vi|Thế kỷ 8|wa|8inme sieke|war|Ika-8 nga gatostuig|wuu|8世纪|xmf|VIII ოშწანურა|yi|8טער י"ה|zh|8世纪|zh_min_nan|8 sè-kí|zh_yue|8世紀|qid=Q8086}}, in the reign of {{ill|Emperor Monmu|Q357246|qid=Q357246}}, a shrine hall of 7 bays was built with a small corner width of 5 {{ill|Ken (unit)|Q3195007|qid=Q3195007}}, and later in the age of {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|Q349263|qid=Q349263}}, {{ill|Gyōki|Q1136664|qid=Q1136664}} petitioned and temple halls and shrine buildings were constructed. The site was later destroyed by war fire in the {{ill|Ōnin|Q1143903|qid=Q1143903}} era, but in {{ill|1595|Q6782|qid=Q6782}} ({{ill|Bunroku|Q1373039|qid=Q1373039}} 3) a two-by-four-bay shrine hall was rebuilt. In {{ill|1600|Q6720|qid=Q6720}} ({{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 6), its thatched roof was repaired.<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url= http://kamnavi.jp/en/izumi/yamadai.htm |publisher=Kannabi|title=Yamadai Shrine|accessdate=2020-06-20}}</ref>. It was an Engishiki inner shrine and once had a temple-shrine of this sanctuary called Chōkō-ji, but was separated by {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}}. In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5) it was ranked {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029|lt=village shrine}}, and in Meiji 44 it merged Yaoyorozu Shrine and Kijima Shrine<ref>Local information signboard</ref>.

=== Cultural properties / Natural monuments ===
In {{ill|1973|Q2477|qid=Q2477}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 48), three items were designated cultural properties by Osaka Prefecture.
*Honden - built in 1595. {{ill|Chamaecyparis obtusa|Q917187|qid=Q917187}} bark roof, with chidori {{ill|Bargeboard|Q4881511|qid=Q4881511}}.
*Stone komainu - one pair, {{ill|Kyōwa|de|Kyōwa (Ära)|fa|کیووا|fr|Ère Kyōwa|ja|享和|ko|교와|ru|Кёва (нэнго)|simple|Kyōwa|sr|Кјова|sv|Kyōwa|tr|Kyōwa|zh|享和|qid=Q960763}} 4
*Stone lanterns - from {{ill|Hōreki|de|Hōreki|eo|Horeki-epoko|fa|هوره‌کی|fr|Ère Hōreki|it|Hōreki|ja|宝暦|ko|호레키|ru|Хорэки|simple|Hōreki|sr|Хореки|sv|Hōreki|tr|Hōreki|zh|寶曆 (日本)|qid=Q1194397}} 4 to {{ill|Kaei|cs|Kaei|de|Kaei|fa|کائی|fr|Ère Kaei|it|Kaei|ja|嘉永|ko|가에이|ru|Каэй|simple|Kaei|sr|Каеи|sv|Kaei|tr|Kaei|zh|嘉永|qid=Q1146125}} 2
